messages:
Priya: Quick idea - add a lightweight 'Cost provenance' tile tied to the heatmap. Click a cell -> show which prefetches/kv credits fed that route and a tiny sample of invocations (redacted). Helps debug routes with surprising marginal unit cost. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/prov/tile_v2.png :mag:

Hector: Love this. Must be explicit about billing vs quota. Add a badge 'billing estimate' and a link to the formula. Also privacy: redact user text and use hashed ids.

Lin: Telemetry additions: emit `prefetch_id`, `prefetch_origin`, `kv_credit_tokens`, `route_affinity`, `fallback_reason`, `sampled`, `sample_weight`. Keep payload minimal. We'll do heavy lifting in rollups.

Ravi: Rollup plan: ingest raw events, nightly job builds provenance map: prefetch_id -> consuming_route -> uses/tokens. Tiles stored as JSON blobs for Console. Prototype SQL:
```sql
SELECT prefetch_id, consuming_route, COUNT(*) AS uses, SUM(tokens) AS tokens_used
FROM raw_invocations_sampled
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY prefetch_id, consuming_route;
```

Priya: UI interactions: 1) cell click -> list of prefetch_ids + counts, 2) click prefetch_id -> show sampled invocations with redacted fields, 3) "what-if" sim to estimate delta if prefetch disabled. Sim should show formula and confidence.

Jun: Simulation note - gate behind admin perms and a rate limit to avoid surprise quota/ETL costs. Also make the sim non-destructive and cached for 24h.

Hector: For display, show mean + p50/p95 and a shading for confidence derived from `sample_weight` and effective_n. If effective_n < threshold, show an orange warning.

Lin: Privacy: only show gdpr_hash and truncated user-agent. Add org-level opt-out for showing sampled invocation lists.

Ravi: I'll own the ETL job. For alpha use 1/20 sampling and `sample_weight` so estimates are unbiased. Job infra/ETL-502, run MON/WED/FRI.

ops-bot: console-service: feature flag `cost_provenance_alpha` enabled for orgs: redwood-internal, partner-sandbox. Canary rollout 5%.

Priya: Thanks team. I'll write the tooltip copy and the small doc with formulas (amortized vs marginal vs raw) and post mocks here tomorrow. Target internal alpha in 10 days. :rocket:
